youtube.title: Consonant Blends for Kids! bl, fr, st | Blend Bridges | Toy Box Friends
youtube.description:
Frog keeps splashing into the pond because he says his sounds too slowly! Robo shows that a blend is two consonant sounds side by side, said fast, and you can still hear both: bl, fl, cl, pl, fr, cr, dr, tr, st, sn, sl and sw. Kids compare a blend (st, two sounds) with a digraph (sh, one new sound), swap blends to make new words (block, clock, flock) and finish with a bridge quiz.

For first graders learning to read (CCSS RF.1.2.b).

Try at home: with a grown-up, write letters on paper plates and lay them on a rug. Step on each plate and say its sound, then push them together and say both sounds fast: st! Tape the plates down so they don't slip, and step, don't jump.

do.text: Ooh, a flower island! I'll hop across.
Frogs are great jumpers... not great waiters.
Frog, those two sounds want to be said together, fast.
Two sounds, side by side, said fast. That's a blend!
Here are s and t. Listen to each sound.
Listen again. Can you still hear both?
That's a blend. Both sounds stay.
Now try s and h. Listen.
Whoa! That's a brand new sound!
s and h make one new sound. That's a digraph.
A blend keeps both sounds. A digraph makes a new one.
Clap two claps for a blend. One for a digraph!

scenes.title: The L bridges: bl, fl, cl, pl

do.text: The L island! Every blend here ends in l.
First stones: b and l. Listen.
Which picture waits across this bridge?
Plant! The L island is open!
Two little sounds, quick, quick, quick!
Side by side, and they both still stick!

scenes.title: The R bridges: fr, cr, dr, tr

do.text: The R island! These blends end in r.
Say it fast, before the stones lock!
Frog! That's me! My name has a blend!
No splash! Fast is my style now.
Crayon! Crayons are made of wax.

scenes.title: The S bridges: st, sn, sl, sw

do.text: Welcome to the S island. Say the blend to cross!
Stones s and t. Here's my fast try.
Hmm. I only heard one sound.
Oops! I squashed it. Here are both, fast.
Star! Thanks for the fix, Sheep.
Here's block. Let's swap the blend!
Take away b and l. Put in c and l.
Now swap in f and l!
A flock? That's a group of sheep! Friends, come here!
A flock of sheep! Fl, fl, flock!
One small swap makes a brand new word.
Question two. Is sh in ship a blend or a digraph?
Question three. Which starts with s t: star or sun?
Star! Sun has only s at the start.
Question four. Swap b l for c l. What's the new word?
Last question. What blend starts Frog's name?
Every bridge is open! Hop home, Frog!
Twelve bridges and not one splash!
A blend is two sounds, side by side, said fast.
You can still hear both. Bye, bridge builders!
